name: exp_le_exp_of_le
statement: ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a ≤ b → Real.exp a ≤ Real.exp b
docstring: Exponential order: `Real.exp a ≤ Real.exp b` exactly when `a ≤ b`.
why: The statement proves one direction; "exactly when" claims the iff. (The converse happens to be true in Mathlib, but this statement does not prove it.)
